title.zh: 碳和碳的氧化物与燃料

clips.send: Burning fossil fuels transfers carbon from long-term underground stores to the air as CO2.
clips.text: Burning fossil fuels transfers carbon from long-term underground stores to the air as CO₂.

clips.send: CO poisoning happens when CO binds to hemoglobin, the protein in blood that carries oxygen. This interferes with oxygen delivery and can cause headaches, dizziness and even death. If a CO alarm sounds or you suspect poisoning, get to fresh air outside immediately and call emergency services from there (911 in the US).
clips.text: CO poisoning happens when CO binds to hemoglobin, the protein in blood that carries oxygen. This interferes with oxygen delivery and can cause headaches, dizziness and even death. If a CO alarm sounds or you suspect poisoning, get to fresh air outside immediately and call emergency services from there (911 in the US).

clips.send: The surface absorbs sunlight and emits infrared radiation. Greenhouse gases such as CO2 absorb and re-emit some infrared radiation. The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm. Added CO2 strengthens it. Arrows show direction and relative change.
clips.text: The surface absorbs sunlight and emits infrared radiation. Greenhouse gases such as CO₂ absorb and re-emit some infrared radiation. The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm. Added CO₂ strengthens it. Arrows show direction and relative change.

clips.send: CO2 can also leave surface water and return to the air. Ocean–air exchange goes both ways.
clips.text: CO₂ can also leave surface water and return to the air. Ocean–air exchange goes both ways.

clips.send: Some dead material, on land or in the ocean, is buried. Over millions of years, heat and pressure can turn some of it into fossil fuels.
clips.text: Some dead material, on land or in the ocean, is buried. Over millions of years, heat and pressure can turn some of it into fossil fuels.

clips.send: Each carbon atom bonds to three neighbors in a sheet of hexagons. Sheets can slide past one another. Electrons can move along the sheets, so graphite conducts electricity. Three bonded neighbors per carbon atom, all in its sheet.
clips.text: Each carbon atom bonds to three neighbors in a sheet of hexagons. Sheets can slide past one another. Electrons can move along the sheets, so graphite conducts electricity. Three bonded neighbors per carbon atom, all in its sheet.

clips.send: Why is the CO2 heavier than the methane used? The oxygen in CO2 comes from O2 in the air. Count the water as well when comparing total masses.
clips.text: Why is the CO₂ heavier than the methane used? The oxygen in CO₂ comes from O₂ in the air. Count the water as well when comparing total masses.

clips.send: Organisms release CO2 during cellular respiration. Decomposers also return carbon to the air as they break down dead plants and animals.
clips.text: Organisms release CO₂ during cellular respiration. Decomposers also return carbon to the air as they break down dead plants and animals.

clips.send: Some CO2 from the air dissolves in surface seawater. Some of that dissolved CO2 reacts with water to form carbonic acid. The carbon can also enter other dissolved forms or become part of living things.
clips.text: Some CO₂ from the air dissolves in surface seawater. Some of that dissolved CO₂ reacts with water to form carbonic acid. The carbon can also enter other dissolved forms or become part of living things.

clips.send: With less oxygen, incomplete combustion can produce poisonous CO. The model shows one possible outcome.
clips.text: With less oxygen, incomplete combustion can produce poisonous CO. The model shows one possible outcome.

clips.send: Limestone or marble reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid without heating. At the same temperature and pressure, CO2 is denser than air. Feed it near the bottom of an upright jar so it displaces air upward. Some CO2 dissolves in water, so collection over water loses some gas.
clips.text: Limestone or marble reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid without heating. At the same temperature and pressure, CO₂ is denser than air. Feed it near the bottom of an upright jar so it displaces air upward. Some CO₂ dissolves in water, so collection over water loses some gas.

clips.send: A C60 molecule is a hollow cage with a carbon atom at each corner. Its 12 pentagons and 20 hexagons form a pattern like the panels of a soccer ball. 60 atoms in one molecule. Each carbon has three bonded neighbors.
clips.text: A C₆₀ molecule is a hollow cage with a carbon atom at each corner. Its 12 pentagons and 20 hexagons form a pattern like the panels of a soccer ball. 60 atoms in one molecule. Each carbon has three bonded neighbors.

clips.send: Plants take CO2 from the air during photosynthesis and use its carbon to make sugars.
clips.text: Plants take CO₂ from the air during photosynthesis and use its carbon to make sugars.

clips.send: Each carbon atom makes four bonds in a tetrahedral arrangement. The bonds form a rigid three-dimensional network, which makes diamond very hard. Four bonded neighbors per carbon atom.
clips.text: Each carbon atom makes four bonds in a tetrahedral arrangement. The bonds form a rigid three-dimensional network, which makes diamond very hard. Four bonded neighbors per carbon atom.

clips.send: A fire goes out when fuel is removed or cut off, oxygen is cut off, or the burning material cools below its ignition temperature. Cooling changes the fuel’s current temperature. Each toggle sets up a new situation in the model.
clips.text: A fire goes out when fuel is removed or cut off, oxygen is cut off, or the burning material cools below its ignition temperature. Cooling changes the fuel’s current temperature. Each toggle sets up a new situation in the model.

clips.send: A lid limits the oxygen supply to a small grease fire. Water can splash burning oil and spread the fire. If there is a fire, get to safety and call the fire department.
clips.text: A lid limits the oxygen supply to a small grease fire. Water can splash burning oil and spread the fire. If there is a fire, get to safety and call the fire department.

clips.send: The same two carbon atoms get enough oxygen to form two CO2 molecules. The equation shows the simplest ratio.
clips.text: The same two carbon atoms get enough oxygen to form two CO₂ molecules. The equation shows the simplest ratio.

clips.send: Black copper(II) oxide loses oxygen and forms reddish copper. That is reduction. Carbon gains oxygen and forms carbon dioxide, so carbon is oxidized. Carbon is the reducing agent.
clips.text: Black copper(II) oxide loses oxygen and forms reddish copper. That is reduction. Carbon gains oxygen and forms carbon dioxide, so carbon is oxidized. Carbon is the reducing agent.

clips.send: 锅里的油刚冒出小火苗时，锅盖能阻隔空气，限制氧气供应。往燃烧的油里倒水会使油飞溅，让火势蔓延。遇到火情，先撤离到安全地点，再呼叫消防救援。
clips.text: 锅里的油刚冒出小火苗时，锅盖能阻隔空气，限制氧气供应。往燃烧的油里倒水会使油飞溅，让火势蔓延。遇到火情，先撤离到安全地点，再呼叫消防救援。

clips.send: 黑色氧化铜失去氧，生成红色的铜，这一变化叫还原。碳得到氧，生成二氧化碳，碳被氧化。碳是还原剂。
clips.text: 黑色氧化yǎnghuà铜失去氧，生成红色的铜，这一变化叫还原。碳得到氧，生成二氧化碳，碳被氧化。碳是还原剂。

clips.send: 空气中的一部分 CO2 溶于表层海水。其中一部分会与水反应生成碳酸。碳也可以变成水中的其他溶解成分，或进入海洋生物体内。
clips.text: 空气中的一部分 CO₂ 溶于表层海水。其中一部分会与水反应生成碳酸。碳也可以变成水中的其他溶解成分，或进入海洋生物体内。

clips.send: 同一层内，每个碳原子与三个相邻的碳原子成键，形成六边形网格。石墨的各层之间可以滑动，电子可以沿层移动，所以石墨能导电。 每个碳原子都与同一层内的三个相邻碳原子成键。
clips.text: 同一层内，每个碳原子与三个相邻的碳原子成键，形成六边形网格。石墨的各层之间可以滑动，电子可以沿层移动，所以石墨能导电。 每个碳原子都与同一层内的三个相邻碳原子成键。

clips.send: C60 分子呈空心笼状，每个顶点都有一个碳原子。12 个五元环和 20 个六元环排列成类似足球表面的图案。 一个分子含 60 个碳原子，每个碳原子与三个相邻的碳原子成键。
clips.text: C₆₀ 分子呈空心笼状，每个顶点都有一个碳原子。12 个五元环和 20 个六元环排列成类似足球表面的图案。 一个分子含 60 个碳原子，每个碳原子与三个相邻的碳原子成键。

clips.send: 一氧化碳中毒：CO 与血液中负责运送氧气的血红蛋白 dànbái结合，妨碍氧气输送，可引起头痛、头晕，甚至死亡。若一氧化碳报警器响起或怀疑有人中毒，应立即到室外呼吸新鲜空气，并在室外拨打急救电话（美国为 911）。
clips.text: 一氧化yǎnghuà碳中毒：CO 与血液xuèyè中负责运送氧气的血红蛋白xuèhóng dànbái结合，妨碍氧气输送，可引起头痛、头晕tóuyūn，甚至死亡。若一氧化碳报警器响起或怀疑有人中毒，应立即到室外呼吸新鲜空气，并在室外拨打急救电话（美国为 911）。

clips.send: 陆地和海洋中都有一部分生物遗体被埋藏。经过数百万年，其中一部分可在温度和压力的作用下形成化石燃料。
clips.text: 陆地和海洋中都有一部分生物遗体被埋藏。经过数百万年，其中一部分可在温度和压力的作用下形成化石燃料。

clips.send: 化石燃料燃烧，把长期储存在地下的碳以 CO2 的形式释放到大气中。
clips.text: 化石燃料燃烧，把长期储存在地下的碳以 CO₂ 的形式释放到大气中。

clips.send: 每个碳原子与四个相邻的碳原子成键，这四个原子位于四面体的四个顶点。牢固的立体网状结构使金刚石具有很高的硬度。 每个碳原子与四个邻近的碳原子成键。
clips.text: 每个碳原子与四个相邻的碳原子成键，这四个原子位于四面体的四个顶点。牢固的立体网状结构使金刚石具有很高的硬度。 每个碳原子与四个邻近的碳原子成键。

clips.send: 地表吸收阳光后发出红外辐射。CO2 等温室气体会吸收并重新发出部分红外辐射。自然温室效应使地球保持温暖；人为增加的 CO2 会加强这一效应。箭头只表示方向和相对变化。
clips.text: 地表吸收阳光后发出红外辐射。CO₂ 等温室气体会吸收并重新发出部分红外辐射。自然温室效应使地球保持温暖；人为增加的 CO₂ 会加强这一效应。箭头只表示方向和相对变化。

clips.send: 灭火可以移走可燃物、切断燃料供应、隔绝氧气，或将可燃物冷却到着火点以下。冷却降低的是可燃物当前的温度。模型中的每次切换都表示一组新的燃烧条件。
clips.text: 灭火可以移走可燃物、切断燃料供应、隔绝氧气，或将可燃物冷却到着火zháohuǒ点以下。冷却降低的是可燃物当前的温度。模型中的每次切换都表示一组新的燃烧条件。

clips.send: 海水中的 CO2 也能从海面逸出，进入大气。海洋与大气之间的交换是双向的。
clips.text: 海水中的 CO₂ 也能从海面逸出，进入大气。海洋与大气之间的交换是双向的。

clips.send: 植物在光合作用中吸收空气中的 CO2，用其中的碳合成糖。
clips.text: 植物在光合作用中吸收空气中的 CO₂，用其中的碳合成糖。

clips.send: 用石灰石或大理石与稀盐酸反应，无需加热。同温同压下，CO2 的密度比空气大，适合用向上排空气法收集。集气瓶正放，导管伸近瓶底，空气从瓶口排出。CO2 在水中有一定溶解度，排水收集会损失一部分气体。
clips.text: 用石灰石或大理石与稀盐酸反应，无需加热。同温同压下，CO₂ 的密度比空气大，适合用向上排空气法收集。集气瓶正放，导管伸近瓶底，空气从瓶口排出。CO₂ 在水中有一定溶解度，排水收集会损失一部分气体。

clips.send: 同样是两个碳原子，供氧充足时可形成两个 CO2 分子。方程式给出最简整数比。
clips.text: 同样是两个碳原子，供氧充足时可形成两个 CO₂ 分子。方程式给出最简整数比。

clips.send: CO2 为什么比消耗的甲烷重？CO2 中氧原子的质量来自空气中的 O2。计算总质量时，还要计入生成的水。
clips.text: CO₂ 为什么比消耗的甲烷jiǎwán重？CO₂ 中氧原子的质量来自空气中的 O₂。计算总质量时，还要计入生成的水。

clips.send: 生物通过呼吸作用释放 CO2。分解者分解动植物遗体时，也会把其中的碳释放到大气中。
clips.text: 生物通过呼吸作用释放 CO₂。分解者分解动植物遗体时，也会把其中的碳释放到大气中。

clips.send: 化石燃料燃烧，把长期储存在地下的碳以 CO2 的形式释放到大气中。
clips.text: 化石huàshí燃料燃烧，把长期储存在地下的碳以 CO₂ 的形式释放到大气中。

clips.send: 供氧不足时，不完全燃烧可能生成有毒的 CO。模型展示了其中一种可能的结果。
